correctness.rationale: The once-subdivided K3,4 meets Abrams n=3 sufficient-subdivision conditions, so its explicit unordered cubical complex computes the actual space. Exhaustive enumeration gives chain dimensions (969,3264,3510,1192); both integral boundary-square compositions vanish. Mod-three rank lower bounds (968,2290,1192) become exact rational ranks because rank d1<=968, rank d3<=1192 and H1 surjects onto the 6-dimensional H1(K3,4) using one moving particle around every generating 4-cycle with two others fixed externally, hence rank d2<=3264-968-6=2290. Thus rational Betti ranks (1,6,28,0) are proved, not inferred from modular ranks alone. The trajectory quotient is equivariant and equal-dimensional, giving H1 graph-cycle character. Signed Lefschetz calculations enumerate all 144 automorphisms, verify integral differential equivariance on 15 class representatives and give the exact 15-class H2 character; rational character inner products yield the seven stated irreducible constituent types (one occurring twice). Source and full output are included.

originality.rationale: Exact subject is the fifteen-class S3×S4 rational H2 representation of three unordered points on geometric K3,4 (dimension 28), not merely the known H1 or the known family chain model. Ko–Park Theorem 3.16 computes H1 but not H2; Maciążek–Sawicki give K3,3 and K2,p examples but not this unbalanced graph, and their restricted general results do not contain three degree-four vertices. Ramos–Yun 2026 computes two-point balanced K_n,n representations under a diagonal S_n and three points on complete graphs; its inspected sections do not imply the present claim. Published mathematical-record searches give K3,4 Morse-complex and K5,4 four-particle results, neither implying the present object, particle count, or representation. Priority remains provisional to inspected evidence.
residual_risks: Unindexed or non-digitized equivalent character computations remain possible; absence from the checked sources does not prove absolute priority.
The full invariant is rational: no integral H2 torsion or integral equivariant lattice classification is claimed.
Reproducible finite computations are same-model checked, without independent mathematical audit.

value.rationale: The complete bipartite K3,4 is the smallest unbalanced nonplanar complete bipartite graph directly extending the classical K3,3, and three point configuration homology is a natural graph-braid invariant. Its exact 28-dimensional H2 symmetry character with seven nonisomorphic constituents and multiplicities is finer than the known H1 and numerical Betti data. The seven-constituent-type S3×S4 classification is a motivated canonical exact invariant and a possible benchmark for higher graph-braid representations; no downstream all-family theorem is asserted.
